name: BACH_0240
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (99%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class set, reliable input, and both models agree [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 99%, InSitu 1% | One dominant class |
| Conformal set | Invasive only (90%) | No ambiguity |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.998 / 94th percentile | Input not flagged [F6] |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Agrees | Same top class |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive | All neighbors match [F5] |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 1, 3, 10) · ↑ invasive · Strongest association; scored above typical [F2] · Validated
- **Scarce tubule formation** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Low tubule score fits invasive; region 8 has most [F3] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 0, 4, 7) · ↑ invasive · Above typical; small contribution · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 1, 4, 5) · ↑ invasive · Above typical, but failed spot check (0/20) [F4] · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions cuts the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect classifier use. Mitoses is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Nuclei segmentation failed, so no measured cell features corroborate the call.
- The margin call comes from a simulated frozen section; no margin validation was supplied.

## Check on the slide
1. **1, 3, 10**: Confirm tumor cells infiltrate stroma, not reactive stroma.
2. **8**: Strongest tubule signal; check whether the glands are benign.
3. **0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 8, 11**: Confirm tumor reaches the superior, medial and lateral edges [F7].
